groups.title: Prisma Schema and Models
groups.question: You are adding a PostgreSQL database with Prisma to your SvelteKit app for users and their posts. Explain how you would define the models and relations.

followUps.Defining models and fields in schema.pri: How does schema.prisma become a typed client?
followUps.Model relations: one-to-many and many-to: How do you model a user with many posts?

evidence.text: The schema describes tables as models with typed fields.
prisma generate builds a type-safe client from it.
The client must be regenerated after schema changes.
The post stores a foreign key to its user.
Relation fields on both models let you navigate either way.
Defined relations allow nested queries with include.

notEnough: Only saying you add a relation.

groups.title: Migrations and Seeding
groups.question: A teammate changed the schema and everyone's database is now out of sync, and new developers start with empty tables. Explain migrations and seeding.

followUps.Creating and applying database migration: What does prisma migrate dev do?
followUps.Seeding the database with initial data: How do you seed development data?

evidence.text: It writes SQL migration files from schema changes.
It applies them to the local database.
Committed migrations let everyone apply the same changes in order.

notEnough: Only saying it migrates the database.

evidence.text: A seed script creates development data.
It is registered so prisma db seed runs it.
Using upserts makes it safe to run again.

groups.title: Querying in Server Code
groups.question: Your load functions read and write posts, and some return far more data than the page needs. Explain how you would query with Prisma.

followUps.CRUD operations with PrismaClient: Which Prisma methods cover most operations?
followUps.Filtering and selecting fields in querie: How do where, select and include control what you fetch?

evidence.text: findMany, create, update and delete cover most needs.
Each returns typed results that match the schema.
These calls belong in server-only code like +page.server.ts.
where filters rows.
select returns only chosen fields, reducing the payload.
include adds related records.

groups.title: Environment Configuration
groups.question: Your app crashes with too many database connections after editing files, and you are unsure how to read the database URL. Explain the configuration.

followUps.DATABASE_URL env variable setup for Pris: How do Prisma and SvelteKit read DATABASE_URL?
followUps.Singleton PrismaClient pattern in Svelte: Why use a singleton Prisma client?

evidence.text: Prisma reads the connection string from DATABASE_URL.
SvelteKit exposes server-only variables through $env/static/private.
The database URL must never be imported into client code.

notEnough: Only saying you set an env var.

evidence.text: Hot reloading can create a new client on each edit.
Each client has its own connection pool, so connections run out.
Storing one client on globalThis reuses it.

notEnough: Only saying you use a singleton.
